fields.description: Apartments and villas on SHA Emirates Island at AlJurf, planned around beaches, landscaped spaces and wellness facilities.

sources.label: SHA · original residential plan selections, broker-hosted

overview: Apartments, penthouses and three villa categories form IMKAN and SHA’s island community beside a planned wellness resort.
research.locationNote: SHA Emirates Island within AlJurf, Abu Dhabi, between Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
research.priceNote: Knight Frank’s September 2025 launch range was AED 9–130 million. This is a historical range; current unit prices and available releases were not verified.
research.paymentNote: Bayut’s Plan C lists 10/50/40. Other published plans differ; obtain the developer’s dated offer.
research.handoverNote: IMKAN’s 2024 announcement anticipated 2026. Knight Frank’s 2025 launch targeted the first residences for 2027. A unit-specific contractual date and completion certificate were not verified.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Apartment GSA includes balconies; villa BUA covers the whole home, excluding plots.

facts.label: Programme editions
facts.value: 2024: 86 villas, 49 apartments, two penthouses. Subsequent release and plan counts differ.

facts.label: Furniture and pools
facts.value: Furniture optional; confirm pool, landscaping and outbuilding inclusions contractually.
